entry.summary:
LT McGuinness continue construction on the new state-of-the-art archives repository and specialist facilities for Archives New Zealand, National Library of New Zealand and Ngā Taonga Sound & Vision. The exciting new Archives building, expected to open to the public in 2026, involves the collective work of the Department of Internal Affairs and the project’s Fund Managers AMP Capital Ltd. Additionally, the process of co-design, that ensures that the building design captures a te ao Māori worldview, is thanks to Taranaki Whānui Te Atiawa representatives, design agency, Tihei, and architects Warren & Mahoney.

Music by @ikson
